comments.content:
We must include https://dao.ubq.fi/devpool somewhere elegant to provide guidance on how to contribute. 
Ideas:
Easy: as a footer bar can copy the header bar (dark and light mode!) doesn't look that nice 
medium: make a sandwich menu and hide the "login with GitHub" button there, next to a help button which goes to the page. 
Hard: as a pop up (same one as the GitHub rate limiter) that will advise people who are logged in but never completed an issue or registered their wallet. Once they complete they should not see the pop up anymore. 
I would aim for sandwich menu approach. Generally with design I personally like to handle it but I'm not sure I have time to code this week. If somebody else implements this before me within the next few days please aim to do the footer bar instead. 
## Deadline 25 March 2024
